title: The ci-scope merge walker sees paths built at run time
why: The ci-scope-merge-closure walker reads no path built with normpath(), str(), + or an f-string. So actions/ci-alarm/events.json, read at merge/merge.py line 1136, has no merge flag, and a change to it does not run merge's checks. Found by lane sha-hex-followups (#1781; coordinator, 23:05 CST Nov 7).
note: Done check: a red test where a file merge.py reads through a built path is in the merge closure. Unmeasured: how many such reads exist. Slug and title by triage; no source gave one. Waits under the item 384 hold unless the coordinator counts it as a queue fix. 23:09 CST: not a queue fix, because it blocks no merge (coordinator). It waits under the item 384 hold.
